The configured account is registered on demand, and an account already recorded keeps the status it has

A deployment with nowhere to put attachment bytes is refused when the store is built, not at the first upload
A handle sees only its own account's tickets, on the listing path as well as the one that needs an identifier

The same file is one stored object within an account and two separate objects across two accounts
The store attachment bytes go to is never the store the public site is served from, in the deployed configuration as well as the local one
The material store is declared for both the local and the deployed halves of the configuration, naming the same target in each
The platform records client material as one of three named kinds, and the same vocabulary carries conversations and attached files
A material and a reference record rights and provenance in the same six-part form, and read it back unchanged
An ownership or file-sort value outside the permitted set is refused and no record is stored
Republishability and exportability must be stated as true-or-false answers, never omitted and never inferred
Captured and fetched material must name the address it came from; uploaded material is not asked for one
A brief names the site it belongs to and carries a document; one that names no site or says nothing is refused
A material is a valid record before any text has been extracted from it
Material may name the site it was gathered for, or belong to the account at large
A conversation persists as a record found by its session identifier, with the transcript as a comment and the body left for a summary
